question: Where should next quarter's product effort go: access, usability, playback, or billing/support?
ranking_rule: priority_score = severity_sum = complaint_count x mean_severity over complaint+cancellation records; ties by issue_id

top_issues.name: General app malfunction and poor quality
top_issues.description: Users express broad dissatisfaction with app functionality, performance, and overall quality.

examples.quote: It's really bad app not working properly nonsense
Aweful
Worst app ever they only care about money

top_issues.name: Basic features locked behind Premium paywall
top_issues.description: Free users cannot perform basic functions like song selection, lyrics viewing, or skipping without upgrading.

haad hoti hai bhai aab kya mei gaane bhi tumahare marzi se sunu?

top_issues.description: Music cuts out, stops playing, or fails to continue to the next song automatically.
